description: Adds a guest to the selected wedding after explicit confirmation that the person is 13 or older, before collection of their name or contact details. First and last names are required; phone and email are optional. Results return the saved guest details. Age cannot be inferred from names or relationships. Guest notes and dietary details are unsupported. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

age_band.description: Explicit confirmation that the guest is 13 or older, obtained before their name or contact details. Other age bands are ineligible.

phone.description: Guest phone number, including + and its country code

title.description: Courtesy title before the name, e.g. 'Dr.', 'Mrs.', 'Mr.', 'Ms.', 'Mx.', 'Prof.', 'Rev.', 'Hon.'. Empty string clears it. Only when the couple gives one; never put a title in firstName. A title is used only in the addressing column of the guest export and where the couple writes {{title}} or {{formalName}}, never in a casual text.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: add_my_guest
title: Add Guest to My Wedding
